hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: study_name
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: study acronym/name. Case sensitive - should match the case in the file naming

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: has_consent_group
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: select only if there is an indicated consent group for the data

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: study_consent_group
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: leave blank if none indicated, consent group if otherwise i.e. c1

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: input_s3_bucket
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: s3 bucket which holds the vcf files to be annotated

hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.name: output_s3_bucket
hudson.model.StringParameterDefinition.description: s3 bucket where the output should reside

hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.name: terminate_on_completion
hudson.model.BooleanParameterDefinition.description: set to false to keep all ec2s and configuration files for debugging
